description: Batch check: a list of supplier or customer CNPJs becomes a report, one line per company, with the sanctions, the partners on the PEP list, the active debt, the installment plans, the tax benefits, the construction works, the chronic tax debtor list, the slave labor dirty list, the Ibama embargoes and infraction notices, the government contracts, the records at regulatory agencies and BNDES. The service combines the company checks in a report; you do not need to assemble the rows yourself. Retain each source date and unavailable check. A report is not supplier approval.

cnpjs.description: The CNPJs, with or without punctuation (numeric or alphanumeric), up to 200 valid ones per request.
